rules.prompt: Review GitHub pull request #{number} in {repo}: {url}. Use gh to inspect the PR and its diff. Do not edit files. Before posting, list reviews and stop if your account already submitted a review whose body contains 'Inletd automated review for PR #{number}'. Post one COMMENT review through the GitHub reviews API with body 'Inletd automated review for PR #{number}' and concise inline comments on actual changed lines for actionable findings. For each comment, use a valid path, line, and side RIGHT from the current diff. Do not invent findings. If there are no actionable findings, place one clearly labeled 'Inletd smoke test: review completed; no actionable findings' inline comment on the first added line so this test still verifies inline delivery. If there are no added lines, put that message in the review body. Report the review URL when finished.
